display_name: Tri-SIG-TIME 分类分布引导的生成轨迹恢复
description: 与固定原候选相同的 Phase1 源训练和双轨生成架构，新增冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME 对配对 clean 与两条恢复轨迹的分类分布 KL 指导。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发不同于另一个对话的星地恢复网络；只看 Phase1 地面训练测试集；地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；每个星地视图相对同一冻结基座 clean 损失不超过 3 个百分点。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch, FP32, TF32 off; original Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME immutable release

data.representation: R07 paired Phase1 ground clean and corresponding simulated received IQ; 75% received, 25% clean per epoch
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Source paired IQ only; frozen classifier feature guidance; no transmitter labels and no test records

permissions.regime: Phase1 source L_s/U_s; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL features; no target adaptation
permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record prediction; labels opened only after all seven predictions complete
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed fixed Phase1 six practical channel views; no unobserved generalization claim

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch conditional velocity field; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50/11100 for feature and class-distribution guidance
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Full original Tri-SIG-TIME source checkpoint ancestry and exact L_s/U_s physical ID sets
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Phase1 source-only model and source cache; fixed final E50 reader
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final E30, fixed two antithetic four-step paths; no target-dependent tuning or selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU actual checkpoint and independent semantic-gradient smoke; wait for prior r02 controller and GPU worker to terminate; shared lock, >=12000 MB, at most one same-user CUDA process, no foreign user
execution.stop_rule: Wrong source roles/checkpoint, nonfinite output, incomplete prediction or collision stops and preserves artifacts; no performance-based early stop or retry

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 源训练 512 条的标签不可见诊断：最高方差四分位 clean/received top-1 一致率 60.94%，完整结果写入后打印日志故障；该数值不是准确率。
保持双路径训练、30 轮预算和输入不变；loss 增加 0.1×平均 KL(p_F(clean)||p_F(path))，其余 IQ、特征 anchor 与 path agreement 项保持相同。
分类分布来自冻结基座自身；不读取 TX 标签。此前模型 seed 和固定数据／视图不变；E30 固定，不依据测试指标调整或选模。
新候选在原候选全部结束且原 GPU worker 消失后才准入；只读取前序完成状态和进程身份，不读取其指标后决定启动。
完成全部七视图 raw 与 restored 预测并固定后，独立 CPU scorer 才连接真值；模型更新只在源训练期间。

rows.method: Conditional Transformer trajectories with frozen-teacher feature and 0.1 KL class-distribution source guidance
rows.purpose: Preserve classifier distribution under severe source perturbations
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026092701, order 2026110104, training noise 2026110105, fixed inference noise template 2026110103; existing Phase1 split and views
rows.scenario: Phase1 R07 L_s/U_s training; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
rows.budget_ref: 30 epochs x 63000, batch 128, 14790 updates; 47250 received + 15750 clean per epoch; two four-step trajectories and frozen feature guidance
